summary: RELX PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine Director/PDMR shareholding notification. Rosemary Thomson, a PDMR, acquired 910 ordinary shares at GBP 19.76 per share on 3 August 2026 following the exercise of an option under the RELX Group plc 2023 SAYE Share Option Scheme. This is a standard insider transaction disclosure, not a special situation such as a tender offer, acquisition, or restructuring. No deal terms, strategic actions, or unusual corporate events are present.
